reuse.why: Computes expectedAmount with the existing exported getScheduledAmount, the same helper the schedule tables and balance use, with the raw _amount.

duplication.why: No amount logic is re-written; one call to the shared helper.

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal and APIScheduleEntity, the API's existing schedule mapping layer.

scope.why: One type field, one mapping line, a unit test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Any future change to the expected-amount rule flows to the API through the shared helper automatically.
